basics.name: Luis Fernando Barrera
basics.label: Software Engineering Manager — AI-Driven Development
basics.specialty: TypeScript, Kotlin, Flutter, Python | Payments, Finance, Accounting
basics.summary: Software Engineering Manager leading AI-agent-driven development teams. Building payments, finance, and accounting platforms on Kubernetes and Cloudflare. Passionate about transitioning traditional developers into product-minded software engineers through agentic programming workflows and AI-augmented delivery.
about: I build software the way a craftsman builds furniture — with curiosity, care, and the belief that quality is not a metric but a way of life. For 15 years I've followed the same thread: understanding how money moves, how businesses work, how data tells stories. From ERPs to electronic invoicing, from banking migrations to AI-augmented engineering — the drive has always been the same: see the need, understand the system, and build something beautiful that works.

Today I lead engineering teams where AI agents amplify human potential — not replace it. Multiple models (Kimi, Gemini, GLM, Codex) review each other's code while developers focus on what matters: designing tests, shaping products, and understanding the domain. Double-entry accounting isn't just a business rule — it's our quality gate: if it doesn't balance, it doesn't ship. We test at every level (unit, smoke, integration, E2E) and aim for 100% coverage unless justified otherwise.

But code coverage is not the goal. The goal is a product people use and enjoy. ControlERP.mx — an accounting and payroll ERP with real clients — was delivered in under 3 months with agentic programming. Not because we cut corners, but because we thought deeply about what to build before building it. Despacio, que voy de prisa.

I hire for curiosity and enthusiasm over credentials. I teach double-entry accounting to engineers, financial math to developers, and the craft of software to everyone. I lead by coding alongside the team, feeling their pain, and building processes that make quality inevitable. And sometimes I send people home to rest — because creativity needs silence, not overtime.

I am a polyglot programmer (TypeScript, Python, Kotlin, Flutter), a manager who codes, and a lifelong student of how money, data, and technology intersect. I speak Spanish, English, and Portuguese — and I have kept a personal ledger for 10 years. If your project involves symbols like '$¢£€¥%', let's talk.

work.summary: Leading a multi-disciplinary engineering team building payment, finance, and accounting platforms with AI-agent-driven development. Transitioning developers from traditional roles to AI-augmented product and software engineers.
highlights: Lideré un equipo de 6 ingenieros en la entrega de sistemas de contabilidad y pagos, estableciendo una cultura de desarrollo aumentado por agentes de IA — pasando de features de semanas a features de días sin sacrificar calidad en productos financieros regulados.

Entregué **ControlERP.mx** — un sistema de pagaduría con control de partida doble, dispersión SPEI, recibos QR y CFDI de nómina — con clientes reales, en 2.5 meses usando programación agéntica con Django + TypeScript/React.
Entrené al equipo en contabilidad de partida doble, cores bancarios y plataformas de pagos — transformando ingenieros sin background financiero en constructores de sistemas bancarios confiables.

Implementé un proceso de calidad multi-agente: Kimi, Gemini, GLM, Codex y otros modelos revisan el código de la IA mientras los developers diseñan pruebas unitarias, smoke, integración y funcionales. La partida doble es la verificación contable fundamental — si no cuadra, no funciona.
Arquitecté plataformas multi-servicio con TypeScript, Kotlin, Flutter y Python, usando PostgreSQL y SQLite como capa de datos sobre Kubernetes y Cloudflare.
Diseñé un modelo de productividad con IA que maximiza resultados controlando costos — multiplicando la velocidad del equipo sin perder calidad, en una empresa pequeña con recursos limitados.
Integré sistemas de pagos, cumplimiento fiscal (CFDI) y módulos contables en una plataforma financiera cohesiva.

Maintaining 11+ GitHub organizations and multiple open-source libraries.

work.summary: Building experiences for customers to bring money into Nubank in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Using Clojure, Datomic, microservices, and proprietary Nubank technologies (BDC Framework).
highlights: Worked in a full-stack environment using Clojure to deliver in-app experiences with Nubank's proprietary framework in Clojure / Flutter (BDC).
Applied knowledge of banking systems in Brazil (Pix, TED, Boleto), Colombia (Bre-B, ACH, PSE), and Mexico (SPEI) across Nubank microservices.
Delivered a hybrid app/widget in React and Clojure helping the CX team check transfer-in transaction details in Colombia and Mexico, connecting to microservices and GraphQL platforms.
Used AI-powered coding tools (Cursor, Claude, Gemini) to learn and deliver features across unfamiliar tech stacks.
Used Grafana and observability tools to monitor microservices and the proprietary platform.
Collaborated in a multi-country team using English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Worked with CFDI (Mexican electronic fiscal invoice) and Accounts Payable systems.
Implemented an AI service to automate adjudication of claims for labs and medicines.

work.position: Senior Engineering Manager (Integration and Legacy Services)

highlights: Assumed responsibilities of the Director of Banking Services Engineering — liaising between Financial Product Managers, Operations (COO), Legal, and Sales to translate requirements into technical specifications.
Designed two operation architectures: an ideal minimal-change architecture and a budget-constrained version optimizing for engineering practices and regulatory constraints.
Audited Electronic Banking architecture; recommended restructuring the Technology team for efficient implementation.
Managed a team of 4 designing and implementing: financial product quoting, electronic signature (e.firma) for contracts, document templates, and promissory note endorsements with Mifiel blockchain.
Led the Treasury API project for real-time bank account movement queries via REST / Webhook using Kafka, Django, and Topaz — designed as the first step in an Open Banking initiative for Covalto.

work.position: Engineering Manager, Data Engineer, Tech Lead
work.summary: Engineering Manager (Fincore/ESB Squad). Led the quantitative portfolio migration from SOFOM to regulated bank (CNBV), managing $100M+ in assets.
highlights: Led the Portfolio Migration from SOFOM to Banco Covalto — 2 billion Mexican pesos ($100M+ USD) — migrating from in-house Loan Management System to Stefanini's Topaz. Regulated by CNBV.
Wrote financial math and accounting libraries (Pennyworth) to calculate, split, and handle amortization tables, cash flows, and payment application under hard deadlines. Full test coverage.
Wrote a Credit Contract abstraction library with extractors from multiple sources (Loan Management Systems, Excel, Google Sheets).
Led collaboration across all business areas to gather logic from legacy and target systems, creating all transformations in between.
Managed a team of 6 engineers working with legacy payment systems, financial quoting, loan management, and Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) components.
Improved productivity through OKRs, testing culture, clean code, and best architecture practices.

work.summary: Python/Django engineer in the Financial Core (Fincore) team, maintaining loan management systems and designing financial data infrastructure.
highlights: Maintained and developed Loany, a Portfolio Management System for loans and leases using Django and React.
Refactored amortization table calculations to handle grace periods and complex subproducts.
Designed and developed Kardex: a financial transaction database enabling reporting with quantitative and qualitative data.
Audited all loan contracts to ensure correct calculations per subproduct (revolving and simple credit).
Designed the Enterprise Service Bus architecture for cross-system message processing, inspired by Django middleware patterns.

Installed, configured, and managed the Kubernetes cluster with distributed storage for scrapers (Ragnatela project).
Refactored a distributed Scrapy-based framework using Redis as a distributed queue.
Designed Silk in Django: an API and management system for organizing data sources, schemas, and collection tasks for Latin American business data.
Worked remotely and asynchronously with a distributed team across Israel, Croatia, and Russia.

projects.name: ControlERP.mx
projects.description: Sistema de pagaduría, nóminas y control de efectivo
projects.summary: Sistema de pagaduría para empresas que dispersan efectivo: control de partida doble de cuentas por pagar, dispersión vía SPEI (Sitespay/ASP), recibos de nómina con QR y CFDI de nómina integrado. Entregado en 2.5 meses con programación agéntica.
highlights: Construido como ingeniero principal usando programación agéntica con Django + TypeScript/React.
Resuelve el ciclo completo de pagaduría: a quién le debemos (partida doble) → a quién le pagamos (dispersión SPEI) → control de efectivo con recibos QR → CFDI de nómina.
Conectado al API de Sitespay para dispersión de pagos.
Entregado en 2.5 meses; posteriormente delegado a un desarrollador junior que onboardeó gracias a los conceptos de partida doble ya establecidos.

projects.name: Pennyworth

Calculates regular interest, moratory interest, penalties, and fees using product-specific algorithms with accounting consistency (debits and credits).
